description: This file contains server-side logic for the StartExam.aspx page in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, dynamic population of course dropdown based on user semester, navigation, and initiation of different exam types (Theory and MCQ) by interacting with the database. It also handles the selection of exams from grid views and checks for previous attempts.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam ASP.NET page, handling UI events and database interactions for starting and managing exams.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; populates course dropdown based on user semester stored in session.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates the exam process based on selected exam type and course; sets session variables and confirms course availability.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exam from grid, checks if the user has already taken the exam, and if not, initializes exam start.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exam from grid, performs similar checks as theory, and initializes exam start if permitted.
